column1: # National BBAN fields of iban4j (https://github.com/arturmkrtchyan/iban4j, commit
# b2f6be595cdd30cd722ef9d1706da0d100ba8eff) for the registry example of every country code that
# pololei and iban4j both support. Generated once with iban4j's Iban getters; iban4j is no
# dependency of pololei. Empty columns: iban4j returns null. BR is missing: iban4j rejects the
# registry example (alphanumeric bank identifier, see docs/registry-audit.md).
# Read by Iban4jFieldComparisonTest, which lists every expected difference with its reason.
